gameDescriptionHtml:
Hospital of the Undead is an indie horror survival game viewed from a first person perspective. Explore an abandoned hospital for useful items that help you progress while avoiding a number of zombies waiting to catch you.

You wake up in a dizzy state only to find yourself in a nightmarish hospital overrun by a number of zombies. You need to find the keys to the front door to escape. Search the hospital for keys, equipment and consumables that could be helpful for advancing. Your sanity is affected by darkness so avoid spending too much time in unlit areas. Shoot or run from zombies to prevent getting caught.

Explore the hospital. Unlock doors and search the furnishings for useful inventory items such as keys, weapon, ammunition, batteries, medicines etc.

Explore unilluminated rooms by finding something that helps you see in the dark. Avoid spending too much time in them to preserve your sanity.

Shoot zombies to prevent them from catching you as it leads to an instant death. Shooting without an aim reduces accuracy.
